name: fmp_most_active
description:
Today's most actively traded stocks by volume from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/stock-market-most-active): symbol, name, price, change and change %.
Returns {most_active}: the list of stocks (empty if FMP returns no list).
Inputs (* required): limit (integer, number of stocks; default 5).
Siblings: fmp_market_gainers, fmp_market_losers; sector moves: fmp_sector_performance.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"limit": 10}
